notes.title: Update 2025/01/19
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

This update addresses some feedback we received regarding checkpoints, specifically in multiplayer. There were some cases where checkpoints weren't correctly applied for players, so even though you passed a checkpoint, you would still get sent back to spawn.

Additionally, we realized it's no fun having to wait for your friends, so we now added the option for shared checkpoints. Enabling this will allow all players to go to the same checkpoint, even if they themselves haven't reached it yet but another player in the lobby has. 

Lastly, we already had Ukrainian support, but now we've also added Russian support, добро пожаловать!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[b]Additions ⭐[/b]
🤩 Checkpoints can now be shared between all players or individually
🤩 Added Russian

[b]Bugfixes 🪲[/b]
🐛 Fixed checkpoints not correctly persisting in multiplayer
🐛 Minor collider changes for better game flow
🐛 Fixed localization inconsistencies

notes.title: Update 2024/09/02
notes.content:
Hi all!

We're here with another update, this time adding [b]checkpoints[/b]. To be fair, we were a bit disappointed when we saw so many people simply lacked the skill to reach the further stages, but alas, we can't all be perfect...

You can now enable checkpoints from the game lobby screen, which will allow you to save your progress along the way. Do note that games played with checkpoints do not count for the global leaderboard. 

There are 4 checkpoints along [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3322612816]the map[/url]:
[list]
[*] Beginning of the first park
[*] Marketplace entrance
[*] Marketplace end
[*] Beginning of the second park
[/list]

Happy delivering!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
Additions ⭐
🤩 Added the ability to enable checkpoints
🤩 You can now see the leaderboards without having to finish the game
🤩 Added Ukrainian

Bugfixes 🪲

🐛 Added a delay between respawn voice lines
🐛 Fixed a bug when reassigning controls
🐛 Fixed a bug where music would stop when a song change happened while paused

notes.title: Unicycle Pizza Time is out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Unicycle Pizza Time! has come out, and it's time to become the unbalanced deliver driver you've always dreamed to be. We hope you enjoy the experience, even if there will be points where you feel like throwing your controller through the screen. 

We also understand that there is simply no amount of QA we can do that would solve all problems on launch, so we're here for you as well. 

If you encounter any bugs, please share these with us in our [url=https://discord.gg/WSus22f8aM]Discord[/url], or through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3138570/discussions/]Steam community discussions[/url]. We'll try to solve these as fast as possible. 

As for what else we've got in the pipeline, when we were doing some more trial runs the week before release, we started receiving some comments regarding the [b]implementation of savepoints[/b]. We personally felt like this wasn't something we should add as the entire point of this genre is to have the big resets. 

Depending on the amount of feedback we receive, we may still add this as a later update, where you can have more of a "training mode". Until then, I will just respond "skill issue". 

Other than that, in the long we are looking at adding at least one extra level in the form of a free v1.1 update, there's no exact timeline for it though, but I'd still say somewhere in 2024. 

And that's all I have to say for now, we're not fully done with Unicycle Pizza Time! yet, but would like to see now where the larger playerbase as a whole is struggling with, before addressing these. 

Happy delivering!

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
A question we often got asked is whether we would support Steam Deck, and the answer to that is a resounding [i]yes[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146170/f722cec226edae392a49dfe1531b64abc1c0f9b1.png[/img]

This post is just to give you a bit more of an idea of what to expect whilst we're waiting on Steam's official rating. 

[h2]Controls & Navigation[/h2]
Since we were going for full controller support for this game, it only makes sense we have support for Steam Deck as well. Controls are rebindable in-game and we also have full Steam Input support. Personally I feel you have a bit more finetuned control in-game when using KBM, but we've been able to finish the game as well using only the deck's controller. 

The only thing[b] we are missing but are actively working on is menu navigation using the DPad[/b], for now you will have to use either the left joystick or the touchscreen for this. Expect this to be fixed soon.

[h2]Performance[/h2]
To give you a better idea of how performance will look, these are the stats from one of our heaviest areas in the game, having different TDP limits and their accompanying framerates.
[list]
[*] 3W - ~45FPS
[*] 4W - ~64FPS
[*] 5W - ~80FPS
[*] 10W - ~120FPS
[*] 15W - ~170FPS
[/list]
This means you don't even need to worry too much about your battery being drained!

[h2]Support[/h2]

Should you still experience some issues with deck, you can let us know through either [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3138570/discussions/]Steam discussions [/url]or in our [url=https://discord.gg/WSus22f8aM]Discord [/url]server. 

Happy delivering!
